_comment: Compose with: node tools/screenshots/compose.mjs apps/quizday/store/screenshots.json apps/quizday/store/screenshots/en-US. Raw captures come from app-verify (apps/quizday/qa) and are copied into store/raw. The frame is the app's own newsprint and ink, not a generic gradient. Titles lead with the promise from SPEC.md, then the wedge: no ads, nothing runs out, every answer explained.
